import sys,json,tarfile,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
r=Path(sys.argv[1]);a=Path(sys.argv[2]);j=json.loads(sys.argv[3]);assert hashlib.sha256(a.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==j['archive']
with tarfile.open(a) as t:
 members=t.getmembers();assert len(members)==len(j['files']) and all(x.isfile() and x.name in j['files'] for x in members)
 for x in members:
  b=t.extractfile(x).read();assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==j['files'][x.name];p=r/'tools'/x.name;assert not p.exists();p.write_bytes(b);p.chmod(0o644)
print(json.dumps({'status':'PASS_TOOL_INSTALL_ONLY','hashes':j['files']}))
